note: Every value here is fixed before the pilot runs. The pilot may supply two nuisance parameters and nothing else; it may not supply, and is never shown, the direction or magnitude of any arm contrast. The rule then reports what the frozen envelope can detect. It never solves for the N that detects what the pilot happened to show.

fields.hold_rule: HOLD if any fixed repository has fewer than 5 buildable confirmatory candidates, or if the detectable effect computed at the frozen envelope from the pilot's nuisance parameters exceeds minimum_practically_important_dsfps_effect. In the second case the study reports that it cannot detect an effect worth acting on and stops. It does not lower the minimum important effect to match what it can detect, and it does not raise N beyond maximum_resource_budget_episodes.

minimum_important_effect_rationale: 15 percentage points of Decision-Safe First-Pass Success. Below roughly this size a maintainer weighing whether to adopt automatic delivery would be trading a per-commit hook and a token cost against a difference they could not observe in their own repository within a quarter's work. The figure is a product judgement made before any outcome exists and it is the study author's, not the owner's; it is the one value in this file that the owner should confirm or replace before the pilot, and replacing it changes what the envelope must deliver rather than what the envelope is.

envelope_arithmetic.assumptions: equal-weight Delta over four fixed strata; Var(D_r) = (tau^2 + 2p(1-p)/R) / m_r; baseline p = 0.5, the worst case; candidates per repository = the confirmatory reserve 7 / 14 / 19 / 10, which assumes every reserve candidate turns out buildable
envelope_arithmetic.why_repeats_is_8: 8 repeats per arm is the smallest registered envelope whose detectable effect stays at or under 15 points across the plausible range of between-candidate heterogeneity up to tau^2 = 0.03. It costs 800 episodes, and with the 10% infrastructure allowance the budget is 880.
envelope_arithmetic.the_tension_this_exposes: The corpus cannot detect a small effect. Reaching 10 points needs 12 repeats and only if candidates are homogeneous; at tau^2 = 0.06 even 20 repeats and 2,000 episodes leaves 14.3 points undetectable. This is a property of a 50-candidate corpus spread over four fixed strata, and no analysis choice removes it. It is registered here, before the pilot, so that a later result reported as null cannot be read as evidence of no effect when it is evidence of an underpowered corpus.

what_this_rule_may_not_do: read the pilot's estimated treatment effect, in any form or under any name
choose repeats_per_arm or the candidate set after the pilot
lower minimum_practically_important_dsfps_effect to fit what the envelope can detect
